qualification: Every mode executes all20 case IDs in the same fixed order, with TAP-derived status joined to one canonical C2SOURCE frame per case (including failure finally). qualified means suite exit0 and all20pass; Root separately recognizes expected baseline/mutant failure. No skip/todo/cancel/unknown/missing/extra case qualifies.
counterSemantics: Actual storage snapshot after each case; preparation counters excluding one bootstrap upload/activation. First17 cases use main graph; last3 use their own isolated compiled graph, counted from its own bootstrap. No inherited frame counters, no resets within a graph, no missing observation may stand in for a zero. Integers0..3.
frame: Exactly C2SOURCE SPACE + JSON.stringify({id,status,phase,counters:{upload,activation,receipts},code}) + LF in insertion order. No other fields. Finally emits even failed assertion. Raw TAP only captured in RAM; never published.
captureFailure: CAPTURE_INVALID is a runner error code, never a synthetic case. It makes qualified false and stops with no qualifying receipt; raw exceptions are suppressed.

contextTypes.proposalIndexHash: lowercase SHA256 over exact UTF8 bytes of source-index.json; index does not contain its own hash or runner/workflow
contextTypes.head: 40 lowercase hex from GITHUB_SHA and local git HEAD
contextTypes.tree: 40 lowercase hex from local git HEAD^{tree}

publicFrame: Exactly one AFW_C2_SOURCE_RECEIPT SPACE + JSON.stringify(receipt) + LF. No TAP/assertions/raw exception/headers/cookies/JWT/nonces or other receipt frames are public.

selection.name: T2 finite dispatch never falls through ordinary
T2 closed mounted conduits cannot authorize business
T3 same initial bytes produce connection and downstream
B2b only actual finite alarm with no initial records delegates nominal unchanged
Unit2a unresolved issuer prefix refuses initial alarm without inventing authority
R2 native monitoring revoke rejects foreign revision and sequence
R2 native monitoring revoke enforces native C1 and child window
pure fixed GET wire rejects caller authority and noncanonical metadata
notice cookie-list accepts token names and legitimate values
notice cookie-list bounds assertion and native header envelope

arguments: --test-name-pattern=^(T2 finite dispatch never falls through ordinary|T2 closed mounted conduits cannot authorize business|T3 same initial bytes produce connection and downstream|B2b only actual finite alarm with no initial records delegates nominal unchanged|Unit2a unresolved issuer prefix refuses initial alarm without inventing authority|R2 native monitoring revoke rejects foreign revision and sequence|R2 native monitoring revoke enforces native C1 and child window|pure fixed GET wire rejects caller authority and noncanonical metadata|notice cookie-list accepts token names and legitimate values|notice cookie-list rejects malformed list|notice cookie-list bounds assertion and native header envelope)$

regressions.qualification: Executed only against green proposal; exact11 TAP results, exit0, allpass, zero skip/todo/cancel/unknown/missing/extra. Filtered-out tests are declared outside coverage, never invented TAP; no excluded observed inventory.

isolation.method: sudo -n unshare --net; fixed shell sets loopback UP; --import guard checks onlylo interfaces; no routes or remote egress; unavailable isolation fails closed.
sourceEnvironment: PATH fixed Node22.23.4 binary dir plus /usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
